name: Ryoujoku Koukan Nikki [Shukuchokushitsu Hen] ~Higaisha no Watashi to Kagaisha no Sensei~
original_name: 陵辱交換日記[宿直室編] 〜被害者の私と加害者の先生〜
source:
Ayase was kept after by her teacher. 
That's the day she started keeping a diary... 
His r*pes were many and ongoing. 
When her voice gave out, all that was left was to endure... 

Today she's here again in the "night duty room", 
where she and her r*pist secretly rendezvous...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE169634.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
绫濑被老师跟踪。
从那天起，她开始写日记…… 
他的犯罪行为很多并且持续不断。
当她的声音消失后，只剩下忍耐…… 

今天她又来到“值班室”，
她和她的强奸犯秘密会面的地方……
